golden_rules.query: Is DST810 storing calibration data?
golden_rules.test_method: Check device memory through CAST app interface
golden_rules.failure_indication: Calibration settings lost after power cycle

golden_rules.query: Are heel angle calibrations complete?
golden_rules.test_method: Review calibration points in CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Missing heel angle calibration points

golden_rules.query: Are speed calibrations complete?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify speed calibration points in CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incomplete speed calibration range

golden_rules.query: Is NMEA 2000 network receiving speed data?
golden_rules.expected_value: Calibrated speed data transmitted to network
golden_rules.test_method: Check NMEA 2000 network data feed
golden_rules.failure_indication: No speed data on network or uncalibrated data

golden_rules.query: Is wireless connectivity functional?
golden_rules.expected_value: Device connects wirelessly to CAST app
golden_rules.test_method: Attempt wireless connection through CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Unable to establish wireless connection

golden_rules.query: What is the minimum speed for accurate paddlewheel startup?
golden_rules.test_method: Gradually increase vessel speed and monitor when paddlewheel begins reporting
golden_rules.failure_indication: Paddlewheel not reporting below 0.3 knots indicates potential sensor issue

golden_rules.query: At what speed does the paddlewheel achieve linear performance?
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor speed readings for linear response as vessel speed increases
golden_rules.failure_indication: Non-linear readings at 0.6 knots suggests calibration or paddlewheel issue

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum speed rating for the sensor?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify speed readings at high vessel speeds
golden_rules.failure_indication: Erratic or non-linear readings above 45 knots indicates operating outside specs

golden_rules.query: What is the speed data output frequency?
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor data output timing using diagnostic tools
golden_rules.failure_indication: Lower frequency output indicates potential communication or sensor issue

golden_rules.query: Does the sensor support heel-compensated speed calibration?
golden_rules.test_method: Perform calibration at various heel angles using CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Unable to calibrate at different heel angles suggests sensor or app malfunction

golden_rules.query: What is the minimum speed for accurate paddlewheel response?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify speed readings at low speed operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: No speed reading below 0.3 knots indicates sensor failure

golden_rules.query: At what speed does paddlewheel reading become linear?
golden_rules.test_method: Plot speed readings vs actual speed
golden_rules.failure_indication: Non-linear readings above 0.6 knots indicate malfunction

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum speed rating?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify readings at high speed operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Erratic readings or failure above 45 knots

golden_rules.query: What is the operating voltage range?
golden_rules.test_method: Measure supply voltage at sensor
golden_rules.failure_indication: Device non-functional outside voltage range

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum current draw?
golden_rules.test_method: Measure current consumption
golden_rules.failure_indication: Current draw exceeding 200mA indicates fault

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum hull deadrise angle?
golden_rules.test_method: Measure hull angle at mounting location
golden_rules.failure_indication: Installation on steeper angle may cause inaccurate readings

golden_rules.query: What is the wireless range?
golden_rules.test_method: Test signal strength at various distances
golden_rules.failure_indication: Loss of connection within 30 feet indicates interference or malfunction

golden_rules.query: What is the temperature sensor accuracy?
golden_rules.test_method: Compare against calibrated reference thermometer
golden_rules.failure_indication: Deviation beyond ±0.5°C indicates sensor fault

golden_rules.query: What is the temperature operating range?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify operation across temperature range
golden_rules.failure_indication: Failure outside temperature range

golden_rules.query: What is the minimum depth range?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify depth readings in shallow water
golden_rules.failure_indication: Unable to read depths less than 0.5m

golden_rules.query: Is NMEA 2000 PGN 059904 supported?
golden_rules.expected_value: ISO Request PGN must be functional
golden_rules.test_method: Send ISO Request and verify response
golden_rules.failure_indication: Device not responding to ISO requests

golden_rules.query: Is heartbeat signal present?
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor network for heartbeat PGN
golden_rules.failure_indication: Device offline or malfunctioning

golden_rules.query: Are thread dimensions correct?
golden_rules.test_method: Physical measurement of threads
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incorrect threading may cause mounting issues

golden_rules.query: Is water depth data transmitting?
golden_rules.expected_value: PGN 128267 data streaming with transducer offset
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor NMEA 2000 data stream
golden_rules.failure_indication: Depth sensor malfunction

golden_rules.query: Is self-closing valve functioning?
golden_rules.expected_value: Valve closes automatically when insert removed
golden_rules.test_method: Remove insert and verify valve closure
golden_rules.failure_indication: Water intrusion risk during maintenance
